summary: Practise data preparation, baseline modelling, validation, and decision reporting. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Predictive analytics training covers preparing operational data and building introductory models whose results can be assessed for business decisions. For business and reporting analysts, data science newcomers, and operational professionals, it develops skills in data profiling, baseline regression and classification, and model validation. Learners also interpret evaluation measures and communicate uncertainty in a decision brief; neural networks and production deployment are covered conceptually.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who handle operational data or need to evaluate predictions before recommending a business action. It uses guided Python exercises and does not assume prior data science experience.
prerequisites: Introductory Python coding appears in guided notebook exercises; no previous Python experience is assumed. Basic spreadsheet use and familiarity with workplace data will help you complete the activities.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
Data science & machine learning in practice
